product.name: Monoprice 5-Port 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit Ethernet Unmanaged Switch
product.description: Monoprice™5‑Port Gigabit Ethernet Unmanaged Desktop Switch10/100/1000Mbps, IEEE 802.3ab, Cat5e, Plug and Play, for Gaming and StreamingThe Monoprice™ 5‑Port Gigabit Ethernet Unmanaged Desktop Switch is a simple and reliable way to add additional connections to your network. Easily connect network‑ready devices, such as gaming consoles and streaming devices, for a robust and fast wired network connection. Give users the fastest speeds possible over Cat5e (or better) cabling to distances up to 328 feet (100 meters). This Gigabit Ethernet Switch provides you with a plug and play (no configuration or setup required), high performance, and standards based solution to upgrade your old network to a Gigabit Ethernet network. Its compact size allows you to place it in confined spaces, such as inside a media panel, or even attach it to a wall. For network installers, this switch is an ideal solution to add data drops, especially since its fanless design ensures silent operation.Five 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet portsCompact sizePlug and play, no drivers or configuration requiredSupports Auto Negotiation and Auto MDI/MDIXIEEE 802.3x flow control10Gbps backplane bandwidth2K MAC address table9,216 byte jumbo frame support REDUCE LAG AND REMOVE BOTTLENECKS FROM YOUR NETWORKRemove bottlenecks from your home network by upgrading it to a 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit network with this Gigabit Ethernet switch. Enjoy the fastest possible file transfer speeds and reduced lag with wired connections using Cat5e (or better) cables to distances up to 328 feet (100 meters).PLUG AND PLAYThis switch is a true plug and play device, requiring no drivers or special configuration. Simply plug in your network‑enabled devices, such as computers, laptops, gaming consoles, and video streaming boxes, to get the most out of your home network.COMPACT SIZEMeasuring less than 3.5" wide, this 5‑port Gigabit Switch is compact enough to place in confined spaces, such as media panels or entertainment centers, or mounted to a wall, without taking up too much space.LED INDICATORSThe LED indicators allow you to see your network status at a glance, with simple diagnostics, such as power status and LAN activity/link status for each port individually.SUPPORTS AUTO NEGOTIATION AND AUTO MDI/MDIXThis switch supports Auto Negotiation, allowing it to set the optimal duplex mode and speed to communicate each connected device.
